text:
Sasha: Heads-up: did a targeted perf sweep on host-side request path — tokenization + parse + chunking. Found a small regression vs last week's canary.

Priya: Which regression? overall p50 or tail?

Sasha: Tail. p99 latency for 16k total tokens requests spiked ~18% on host ingress. I captured traces + flame.

Ryan: Can you paste profiling summary?

Sasha: Here's the tail of the wall time from the trace:
```
parse_unmarshal: 14.2ms
tokenize: 9.8ms
writev_flush: 3.1ms
grpc-marshaller: 6.4ms
stream-chunker: 12.6ms
TOTAL_HOST_OVERHEAD: 46.1ms
```
Observation: stream-chunker and parse_unmarshal are the biggest.

Lili: Are we double-copying anywhere? maybe proto unmarshalling allocs.

Priya: I saw a change to protoferry last week — it introduced an extra copy when we switched to batched RPC input. @Ryan any idea?

Ryan: Yup I pushed a change: added a lightweight wrapper to support batched unary->stream bridging. Wanted to avoid lock contention. Looks like the wrapper does a memcpy per frame.

Sasha: Trace shows a small hot func: `protoferry_bridge::copy_frame` - responsible for ~8.7ms. Micro-batching helps but extra copy kills tail.

Priya: Quick mitigation idea: try zero-copy slice of the incoming buffer with refcounted span instead of memcpy. Also look at writev coalescing path — we still do 1-2 extra syscalls for small frames.

Ryan: I have a branch that introduces `SpanRef` and defers final assembly to send path. Benchmarks local: p99 host overhead down 11% for our synthetic.

Sasha: Can you post the benchmark command and results?

Ryan: ```
./ingress_bench --payload=16k --clients=50 --mode=stream
before: p50=18.9ms p99=62.1ms
after-spanref: p50=17.2ms p99=54.9ms
```
But we need CI coverage for memory lifetime safety.

Lili: Also KV cache heat: I noticed extra cache misses correlated with protoferry changes - maybe header slicing changed key boundaries.

Sasha: Good catch. The key normalization moved from pre-parse to post-parse in the patch, so we end up hashing larger buffers. That explains higher memcopy + hash time.

Priya: Action items: 1) revert protoferry memcpy in canary, or gate with feature flag; 2) prototype SpanRef + writev coalescing; 3) add unit test for key normalization boundary; 4) add perf regression alert for host overhead p99.

InfraBot: Deploy note: canary vstg-2026.03.18-ryan1 rolled back to vstg-2026.03.11 per rollback bot.

Sasha: I'll file a small perf PR with the tracing snippet + flame and the regression graph. Also creating an eval run for kernel selection interaction - could quantization change parsing size?

Ryan: I'll open the branch PR and add memory-safety review. ETA EOD.

Priya: :thumbsup: keep the channel posted. If we need hotfix I'll take it.
